import sys


def main():
    t = sys.stdin.buffer.read().replace(b",", b" ").split()
    cats = t[4::3]
    vals = t[5::3]
    sums = {}
    get = sums.get
    for c, v in zip(cats, vals):
        sums[c] = get(c, 0.0) + float(v)
    out = []
    for cat in sorted(sums):
        out.append("%s,%.2f" % (cat.decode(), sums[cat]))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))


main()
